decisions.decision: Put the webview opt-out in `lucy webview serve` behind LUCY_NO_WEBVIEW, not in case.md
decisions.rationale: case.md is byte-frozen with a committed SHA-256 guard and its launch block explicitly forbids extra arguments. An environment variable is the only switch that reaches through the frozen call; a CLI flag would not. case.md stayed byte-unchanged, confirmed via git.
A host setting LUCY_NO_WEBVIEW=0 to mean 'keep the dashboard' must never silently lose it. Guarded by a dedicated parametrised test.
Doing nothing needs no dependency, so a disabled run also succeeds on a host without the [webview] extra.

decisions.decision: Leave the post-run webview running for interactive CASE runs
decisions.rationale: case.md line 945 leaves it up deliberately (WV-07) so a run can be reviewed afterwards. That is correct for interactive use; only headless benchmark runs are leakage. The opt-out targets exactly those.

decisions.decision: Record the benchmark's mixed provenance as an accepted decision, not an open defect
